sentences.en: I'd like to speak to the lady of the household.
sentences.zh: 我想和这家的女主人说话。

sentences.en: I have a few household chores that I must do.
In this household, the women and men share equal responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 在这个家庭里，男女双方承担平等的责任。
